purpose: Teach: 損益/総研/送金/搭乗/事後/カ年/みなし/即し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部門別の損益、総研データを参考に再分析するね。
lines.en: Let's reanalyze the divisional P&L using think-tank data as a reference.
lines.style: Crisp, professional tone. Even pacing, no hesitation. Efficient delivery — moving forward with purpose. Brief eye contact, hands moving slightly for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外送金、事後の確認プロセスを強化します。
lines.en: Got it. I'll strengthen the post-transaction verification process for overseas transfers.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slight nod on the opening. Steady, reliable delivery — the tone of someone taking notes mentally. Calm confidence without flatness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 役員の搭乗予定、5カ年計画と合わせて見直そう。
lines.en: The executives' travel schedule — let's align it with the five-year plan.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight pause before the second clause to signal the connection. Lean back slightly — stepping back to see the bigger picture. Authoritative but not dismissive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: みなし役員規程、新ルールに即して改訂中です。
lines.en: The deemed-officer regulations are being revised to match the new guidelines.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact progress report. Clean delivery, neither rushed nor dragging. Faint note of diligence — showing work is underway. Neutral professional register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Quiet, direct close. Slight drop in volume. The weight of a deadline made polite through brevity. No inflection upward — statement, not question.
